## Description

Air-compressor intake filter referenced by OE number P778989 for the Mitsubishi L200/Storm family, catalogued under the air-compressor subcategory. The source records the Mitsubishi OE number and the compressor application; the parameters here are reference-grade, not source-confirmed. Compressor intake runs a high-velocity, high-dust airflow, so capacity and pressure-drop behaviour matter at least as much as raw efficiency. From a sourcing perspective, buyers should verify the housing form factor and the exact compressor model before ordering, and treat the cross-reference as a discovery aid. Request the spec sheet for dimensions, media and efficiency before a bulk commitment.
